name: Suzu Ballet
description: Suzu Ballet is a calm, classical WordPress block theme for ballet schools, dance academies and movement studios. A high-key studio photograph is clipped to a tall arch with a thin caps headline crossing its shoulders; a mauve panel with a white harlequin lattice holds one inset portrait; a greige photograph band moves slower than the page with a giant word on its bottom edge. The home page opens with a horizontal Wednesday time-card strip and a sticky morning-to-evening day schedule. Outfit for headings, Source Sans 3 for reading. Works as a standalone informational site or with WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
